sanskrit: ā ci̍kitāna su̱kratū̍ de̱vau ma̍rta ri̱śāda̍sā | varu̍ṇāya ṛ̱tape̍śase dadhī̱ta praya̍se ma̱he ||
english: Recognize these two gods of noble will, O mortal, the devourers of enemies — render homage to Varuṇa, fashioner of Order, for his great, benevolent bounty.

sanskrit: tā hi kṣa̱tram avi̍hrutaṁ sa̱myag a̍su̱rya1̱̍m āśā̍te | adha̍ vra̱teva̱ mānu̍ṣa̱ṁ sva1̱̍r ṇa dhā̍yi darśa̱tam ||
english: For those two hold sovereignty that cannot be turned aside, sovereign lordship rightly exercised; and in accordance with their ordinances, the human realm has been established — like heaven made visible.

sanskrit: tā vā̱m eṣe̱ rathā̍nām u̱rvīṁ gavyū̍tim eṣām | rā̱taha̍vyasya suṣṭu̱tiṁ da̱dhṛk stomai̍r manāmahe ||
english: We seek your wide chariot-track for these chariots of yours, O you two; we contemplate the excellent praise of the oblation-giver, firmly, with hymns.

sanskrit: adhā̱ hi kāvyā̍ yu̱vaṁ dakṣa̍sya pū̱rbhir a̍dbhutā | ni ke̱tunā̱ janā̍nāṁ ci̱kethe̍ pūtadakṣasā ||
english: For ye two, O poets of wonder, with the citadels of discernment, perceive the peoples by the banner — ye whose wisdom is purified.

sanskrit: tad ṛ̱tam pṛ̍thivi bṛ̱hac chra̍vae̱ṣa ṛṣī̍ṇām | jra̱ya̱sā̱nāv ara̍m pṛ̱thv ati̍ kṣaranti̱ yāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: That Truth is vast and lofty, the glory of the seers: these two, speeding freely, pour themselves broadly across in their courses.

sanskrit: ā yad vā̍m īyacakṣasā̱ mitra̍ va̱yaṁ ca̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ | vyaci̍ṣṭhe bahu̱pāyye̱ yate̍mahi sva̱rājye̍ ||
english: When, O Mitra, with swift-eyed vision, we and the inspired ones strive toward the two of you in your vast sovereignty, abundant in paths.

sanskrit: baḻ i̱tthā de̍va niṣkṛ̱tam ādi̍tyā yaja̱tam bṛ̱hat | varu̍ṇa̱ mitrārya̍ma̱n varṣi̍ṣṭhaṁ kṣa̱tram ā̍śāthe ||
english: Truly, so it is — O ye Ādityas, ye two gods who give accomplished worship greatly: O Varuṇa, O Mitra, O Aryaman, ye hold the most exalted sovereign power.

sanskrit: ā yad yoni̍ṁ hira̱ṇyaya̱ṁ varu̍ṇa̱ mitra̱ sada̍thaḥ | dha̱rtārā̍ carṣaṇī̱nāṁ ya̱ntaṁ su̱mnaṁ ri̍śādasā ||
english: When, O Varuṇa and Mitra, ye take your seats upon the golden throne — sustainers of the peoples, devourers of enemies — guide your benevolence hither.

sanskrit: viśve̱ hi vi̱śvave̍daso̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | vra̱tā pa̱deva̍ saścire̱ pānti̱ martya̍ṁ ri̱ṣaḥ ||
english: For all-knowing Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman follow all the divine ordinances as if by steps, and guard the mortal from harm.

sanskrit: te hi sa̱tyā ṛ̍ta̱spṛśa̍ ṛ̱tāvā̍no̱ jane̍-jane | su̱nī̱thāsa̍ḥ su̱dāna̍vo̱ 'ṁhoś ci̍d uru̱cakra̍yaḥ ||
english: For these three are truthful, touching the cosmic Order, possessors of Ṛta among every tribe; they are of good guidance and good gift, and even out of distress they make wide paths.

sanskrit: ko nu vā̍m mi̱trāstu̍to̱ varu̍ṇo vā ta̱nūnā̍m | tat su vā̱m eṣa̍te ma̱tir atri̍bhya̱ eṣa̍te ma̱tiḥ ||
english: Who now among those praised by Mitra, or Varuṇa himself, is dear to your persons? This prayer seeks you two — the prayer of the Atris seeks you two.

sanskrit: pra vo̍ mi̱trāya̍ gāyata̱ varu̍ṇāya vi̱pā gi̱rā | mahi̍kṣatrāv ṛ̱tam bṛ̱hat ||
english: Sing forth to Mitra and Varuṇa with the voice of the inspired seer; ye two of vast dominion uphold the great Truth.

sanskrit: sa̱mrājā̱ yā ghṛ̱tayo̍nī mi̱traś co̱bhā varu̍ṇaś ca | de̱vā de̱veṣu̍ praśa̱stā ||
english: Co-sovereigns whose womb is the sacred ghee — both Mitra and Varuṇa — gods renowned among the gods.

sanskrit: tā na̍ḥ śakta̱m pārthi̍vasya ma̱ho rā̱yo di̱vyasya̍ | mahi̍ vāṁ kṣa̱traṁ de̱veṣu̍ ||
english: Grant us of the earthly and the heavenly great wealth — your sovereignty among the gods is mighty.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tam ṛ̱tena̍ sa̱pa̍nteṣi̱raṁ dakṣa̍ṁ āśāte | a̱druhā̍ de̱vau va̍rdhete ||
english: They guard the Truth with Truth and hold swiftly the active discernment; these two gods, free of treachery, grow in greatness.

sanskrit: vṛ̱ṣṭidyā̍vā rī̱tyā̍pe̱ṣas patī̍ dānu̱matyā̍ḥ | bṛ̱hanta̱ṁ garta̍m āśāte ||
english: Lords of the rain-sky and of the streaming waters, lords of the bounteous stream — they occupy the lofty throne.

sanskrit: trī ro̍ca̱nā va̍ruṇa̱ trīm̐r u̱ta dyūn trīṇi̍ mitra dhārayatho̱ rajā̍ṁsi | vā̱vṛ̱dhā̱nāv a̱mati̍ṁ kṣa̱triya̱syānu̍ vra̱taṁ rakṣa̍māṇāv aju̱ryam ||
english: Three luminous realms, O Varuṇa, and three heavens and three spaces of mid-air, O Mitra, ye two sustain; waxing ever greater, ye guard the sagacity of the warrior, upholding the tireless ordinance.

sanskrit: irā̍vatīr varuṇa dhe̱navo̍ vā̱m madhu̍mad vā̱ṁ sindha̍vo mitra duhre | traya̍s tasthur vṛṣa̱bhāsa̍s tisṛ̱ṇāṁ dhi̱ṣaṇā̍nāṁ reto̱dhā vi dyu̱manta̍ḥ ||
english: Waters abundant in refreshment are your cows, O Varuṇa; rivers sweet with honey yield themselves for you, O Mitra; three bulls stand, seminal and brilliant, sowing seed for the three spheres.

sanskrit: prā̱tar de̱vīm adi̍tiṁ johavīmi ma̱dhyaṁdi̍na̱ udi̍tā̱ sūrya̍sya | rā̱ye mi̍trāvaruṇā sa̱rvatā̱teḻe̍ to̱kāya̱ tana̍yāya̱ śaṁ yoḥ ||
english: At dawn I call loudly upon divine Aditi, and at midday when the sun has risen; O Mitra-Varuṇa, I entreat for wealth, for full welfare, for health and bliss for my offspring and my descendants.

sanskrit: yā dha̱rtārā̱ raja̍so roca̱nasyo̱tādi̱tyā di̱vyā pārthi̍vasya | na vā̍ṁ de̱vā a̱mṛtā̱ ā mi̍nanti vra̱tāni̍ mitrāvaruṇā dhru̱vāṇi̍ ||
english: You two, O Ādityas, sustain the shining space of the mid-region and likewise the heavenly and earthly realms — not even the immortal gods infringe upon your fixed and steadfast ordinances, O Mitra-Varuṇa.

sanskrit: pu̱rū̱ruṇā̍ ci̱d dhy asty avo̍ nū̱naṁ vā̍ṁ varuṇa | mitra̱ vaṁsi̍ vāṁ suma̱tim ||
english: For the protection of you two is indeed very great and manifold, O Varuṇa — now, O Mitra, may I win your benevolent grace.

sanskrit: tā vā̍ṁ sa̱myag a̍druhvā̱ṇeṣa̍m aśyāma̱ dhāya̍se | va̱yaṁ te ru̍drā syāma ||
english: May we who are free of treachery rightly obtain nourishment from you two for our sustenance — may we be your Rudrās.

sanskrit: pā̱taṁ no̍ rudrā pā̱yubhi̍r u̱ta trā̍yethāṁ sutrā̱trā | tu̱ryāma̱ dasyū̍n ta̱nūbhi̍ḥ ||
english: Protect us, O Rudrās, with your guards, and defend us — you who give excellent protection; may we overcome the Dasyus with our bodies.

sanskrit: mā kasyā̍dbhutakratū ya̱kṣam bhu̍jemā ta̱nūbhi̍ḥ | mā śeṣa̍sā̱ mā tana̍sā ||
english: O two of wondrous power, may we not suffer with our bodies the affliction of yakṣma-disease, not by a remaining ailment nor by a spreading one.

sanskrit: ā no̍ gantaṁ riśādasā̱ varu̍ṇa̱ mitra̍ ba̱rhaṇā̍ | upe̱maṁ cāru̍m adhva̱ram ||
english: Come to us, O devourers of foes, Varuṇa and Mitra, with great might; approach this pleasing sacrifice.

sanskrit: viśva̍sya̱ hi pra̍cetasā̱ varu̍ṇa̱ mitra̱ rāja̍thaḥ | ī̱śā̱nā pi̍pyata̱ṁ dhiya̍ḥ ||
english: For ye two, O Varuṇa and Mitra, rule as all-seeing sovereigns; as lords, cause our thoughts to overflow with fullness.

sanskrit: upa̍ naḥ su̱tam ā ga̍ta̱ṁ varu̍ṇa̱ mitra̍ dā̱śuṣa̍ḥ | a̱sya soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Come to us here, to the soma-presser who makes offerings, O Varuṇa and Mitra, to drink of this soma.

sanskrit: ā mi̱tre varu̍ṇe va̱yaṁ gī̱rbhir ju̍humo atri̱vat | ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ sadata̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: To Mitra and Varuṇa we call with hymns in the manner of Atri; sit ye down upon the barhis-grass for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: vra̱tena̍ stho dhru̱vakṣe̍mā̱ dharma̍ṇā yāta̱yajja̍nā | ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ sadata̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: By your ordinance ye are of steady abode, by your law making men well-yoked; sit ye down upon the barhis-grass for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: mi̱traś ca̍ no̱ varu̍ṇaś ca ju̱ṣetā̍ṁ ya̱jñam i̱ṣṭaye̍ | ni ba̱rhiṣi̍ sadatā̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: May both Mitra and Varuṇa delight in our sacrifice for the attainment of our wish; may they sit upon the barhis-grass for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: yad a̱dya sthaḥ pa̍rā̱vati̱ yad a̍rvā̱vaty a̍śvinā | yad vā̍ pu̱rū pu̍rubhujā̱ yad a̱ntari̍kṣa̱ ā ga̍tam ||
english: Whether today ye are in the far distance or near at hand, O Aśvins; whether among the many, O ye who give many boons, or come here from mid-air —

sanskrit: i̱ha tyā pu̍ru̱bhūta̍mā pu̱rū daṁsā̍ṁsi̱ bibhra̍tā | va̱ra̱syā yā̱my adhri̍gū hu̱ve tu̱viṣṭa̍mā bhu̱je ||
english: Here now, these two most manifold, bearing many marvels — I approach the two unimpeded ones for the granting of the boon; I call the two most powerful for enjoyment.

sanskrit: ī̱rmānyad vapu̍ṣe̱ vapu̍ś ca̱kraṁ ratha̍sya yemathuḥ | pary a̱nyā nāhu̍ṣā yu̱gā ma̱hnā rajā̍ṁsi dīyathaḥ ||
english: A marvelous form for form's sake ye have fashioned, and the wheel of the chariot ye have set in motion; ye two fly around the yokes and ages of men with greatness across the spaces.

sanskrit: tad ū̱ ṣu vā̍m e̱nā kṛ̱taṁ viśvā̱ yad vā̱m anu̱ ṣṭave̍ | nānā̍ jā̱tāv a̍re̱pasā̱ sam a̱sme bandhu̱m eya̍thuḥ ||
english: That is accomplished by you, and all that is praised of you two; though born differently, ye two, free of blemish, have come together as kinsmen to us.

sanskrit: ā yad vā̍ṁ sū̱ryā ratha̱ṁ tiṣṭha̍d raghu̱ṣyada̱ṁ sadā̍ | pari̍ vām aru̱ṣā vayo̍ ghṛ̱ṇā va̍ranta ā̱tapa̍ḥ ||
english: When Sūryā mounts your swiftly gliding chariot always — the ruddy birds around you two, and the radiant sunshine, clothe you.

sanskrit: yu̱vor atri̍ś ciketati̱ narā̍ su̱mnena̱ ceta̍sā | gha̱rmaṁ yad vā̍m are̱pasa̱ṁ nāsa̍tyā̱snā bhu̍ra̱ṇyati̍ ||
english: For you two, O heroes, Atri perceives with a benevolent spirit; the spotless warmth that the Nāsatyas stir with their lips — he busies himself with that.

sanskrit: u̱gro vā̍ṁ kaku̱ho ya̱yiḥ śṛ̱ṇve yāme̍ṣu saṁta̱niḥ | yad vā̱ṁ daṁso̍bhir aśvi̱nātri̍r narāva̱varta̍ti ||
english: The mighty, tall steed of yours is heard in your courses, ever onward; when by his marvels the Atri turns you Aśvins back, O heroes.

sanskrit: madhva̍ ū̱ ṣu ma̍dhūyuvā̱ rudrā̱ siṣa̍kti pi̱pyuṣī̍ | yat sa̍mu̱drāti̱ parṣa̍thaḥ pa̱kvāḥ pṛkṣo̍ bharanta vām ||
english: O Rudrās who delight in sweetness, a honey-rich stream clings to you, overflowing; when ye two carry across the ocean, the ripe food-gifts they bring to you.

sanskrit: sa̱tyam id vā u̍ aśvinā yu̱vām ā̍hur mayo̱bhuvā̍ | tā yāma̍n yāma̱hūta̍mā̱ yāma̱nn ā mṛ̍ḻa̱yatta̍mā ||
english: Truly indeed, O Aśvins, they call you two bringers of joy; in your course ye are most called upon in the course, and in the course ye are most merciful.

sanskrit: i̱mā brahmā̍ṇi̱ vardha̍nā̱śvibhyā̍ṁ santu̱ śaṁta̍mā | yā takṣā̍ma̱ rathā̍m̐ i̱vāvo̍cāma bṛ̱han nama̍ḥ ||
english: May these sacred utterances be most blissful and strengthening for the two Aśvins — these that we have fashioned as craftsmen fashion chariots; we have spoken the great homage.

sanskrit: kūṣṭho̍ devāv aśvinā̱dyā di̱vo ma̍nāvasū | tac chra̍vatho vṛṣaṇvasū̱ atri̍r vā̱m ā vi̍vāsati ||
english: Where abide you two gods, O Aśvins, today? — O you whose wealth is the mind of heaven; hear this, O two whose wealth is the bull: Atri sets himself to serve you two.

sanskrit: kuha̱ tyā kuha̱ nu śru̱tā di̱vi de̱vā nāsa̍tyā | kasmi̱nn ā ya̍tatho̱ jane̱ ko vā̍ṁ na̱dīnā̱ṁ sacā̍ ||
english: Where — where now are ye heard, O divine Nāsatyas in heaven? Toward which tribe do ye direct yourselves? Who accompanies you by the rivers?

sanskrit: kaṁ yā̍tha̱ḥ kaṁ ha̍ gacchatha̱ḥ kam acchā̍ yuñjāthe̱ ratha̍m | kasya̱ brahmā̍ṇi raṇyatho va̱yaṁ vā̍m uśmasī̱ṣṭaye̍ ||
english: Toward whom do ye travel? To whom do ye go? Toward whom do ye yoke your chariot? Whose sacred words do ye delight in? We are eager for your favour.

sanskrit: pau̱raṁ ci̱d dhy u̍da̱pruta̱m paura̍ pau̱rāya̱ jinva̍thaḥ | yad ī̍ṁ gṛbhī̱tatā̍taye si̱ṁham i̍va dru̱has pa̱de ||
english: Even the city-dweller overwhelmed by water — from the city do ye gladden him for his city's sake, when he is held fast for seizure like a lion at the den of the deceitful.

sanskrit: pra cyavā̍nāj juju̱ruṣo̍ va̱vrim atka̱ṁ na mu̍ñcathaḥ | yuvā̱ yadī̍ kṛ̱thaḥ puna̱r ā kāma̍m ṛṇve va̱dhva̍ḥ ||
english: From Cyavāna, grown old, ye released the withered covering like a garment; when ye make him young again, the young wife's desire is fulfilled.

sanskrit: asti̱ hi vā̍m i̱ha sto̱tā smasi̍ vāṁ sa̱ṁdṛśi̍ śri̱ye | nū śru̱tam ma̱ ā ga̍ta̱m avo̍bhir vājinīvasū ||
english: There is here a praiser of you two; we are in your sight for your glory; now that ye have been heard by me — come with your aids, O two whose wealth is swiftness.

sanskrit: ko vā̍m a̱dya pu̍rū̱ṇām ā va̍vne̱ martyā̍nām | ko vipro̍ vipravāhasā̱ ko ya̱jñair vā̍jinīvasū ||
english: Which among the many mortals has won you two today? Which inspired seer, O ye who carry the inspired ones? Which by sacrifices, O ye whose wealth is swiftness?

sanskrit: ā vā̱ṁ ratho̱ rathā̍nā̱ṁ yeṣṭho̍ yātv aśvinā | pu̱rū ci̍d asma̱yus ti̱ra ā̍ṅgū̱ṣo martye̱ṣv ā ||
english: Let your chariot — the most eager of chariots — come, O Aśvins; the song of praise, desiring us greatly, comes among mortals.

sanskrit: śam ū̱ ṣu vā̍m madhūyuvā̱smāka̍m astu carkṛ̱tiḥ | a̱rvā̱cī̱nā vi̍cetasā̱ vibhi̍ḥ śye̱neva̍ dīyatam ||
english: May our repeated hymn be refreshing and sweet for you two; turn hither with keen minds and fly like eagles with swift wings.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱ yad dha̱ karhi̍ cic chuśrū̱yāta̍m i̱maṁ hava̍m | vasvī̍r ū̱ ṣu vā̱m bhuja̍ḥ pṛ̱ñcanti̱ su vā̱m pṛca̍ḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, whenever ye would hear this call — your gifts are good and they mingle well for you; may these mixed offerings reach you well.

sanskrit: prati̍ pri̱yata̍ma̱ṁ ratha̱ṁ vṛṣa̍ṇaṁ vasu̱vāha̍nam | sto̱tā vā̍m aśvinā̱v ṛṣi̱ḥ stome̍na̱ prati̍ bhūṣati̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: The seer-praiser adorns with his hymn your most beloved chariot, the bull-like, the wealth-bearing; O Aśvins, sweet and honeyed — hear my call.

sanskrit: a̱tyāyā̍tam aśvinā ti̱ro viśvā̍ a̱haṁ sanā̍ | dasrā̱ hira̍ṇyavartanī̱ suṣu̍mnā̱ sindhu̍vāhasā̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Come, O Aśvins, across all primordial ages; O workers of wonder, with golden track, most gracious, borne by the flood — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: ā no̱ ratnā̍ni̱ bibhra̍tā̱v aśvi̍nā̱ gaccha̍taṁ yu̱vam | rudrā̱ hira̍ṇyavartanī juṣā̱ṇā vā̍jinīvasū̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Come to us, ye two Aśvins, bringing your treasures; O Rudrās with the golden track, delighting in it, O ye whose wealth is the swift steed — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: su̱ṣṭubho̍ vāṁ vṛṣaṇvasū̱ rathe̱ vāṇī̱cy āhi̍tā | u̱ta vā̍ṁ kaku̱ho mṛ̱gaḥ pṛkṣa̍ḥ kṛṇoti vāpu̱ṣo mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: On your chariot, O two whose wealth is the bull, the song of excellent praise is set; and the tall beast bears you two nourishment and wonderful forms — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: bo̱dhinma̍nasā ra̱thye̍ṣi̱rā ha̍vana̱śrutā̍ | vibhi̱ś cyavā̍nam aśvinā̱ ni yā̍tho̱ adva̍yāvina̱m mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Awake in mind, swift in the chariot, ye who hear the call — with swift wings ye two Aśvins came down to Cyavāna who was without deceit — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: ā vā̍ṁ narā mano̱yujo 'śvā̍saḥ pruṣi̱tapsa̍vaḥ | vayo̍ vahantu pī̱taye̍ sa̱ha su̱mnebhi̍r aśvinā̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: May your steeds, O heroes, yoked by thought, dappled in form, carry you two for the drinking, together with your graces, O Aśvins — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱v eha ga̍cchata̱ṁ nāsa̍tyā̱ mā vi ve̍natam | ti̱raś ci̍d arya̱yā pari̍ va̱rtir yā̍tam adābhyā̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Come here, O Aśvins, O Nāsatyas, do not miss the mark; even through the hostile one's domain, travel around, ye inviolable — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: a̱smin ya̱jñe a̍dābhyā jari̱tāra̍ṁ śubhas patī | a̱va̱syum a̍śvinā yu̱vaṁ gṛ̱ṇanta̱m upa̍ bhūṣatho̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: At this sacrifice, O inviolable lords of beauty, the praiser who seeks your aid and who lauds you — both of you Aśvins, do ye adorn him — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: abhū̍d u̱ṣā ruśa̍tpaśu̱r āgnir a̍dhāyy ṛ̱tviya̍ḥ | ayo̍ji vāṁ vṛṣaṇvasū̱ ratho̍ dasrā̱v ama̍rtyo̱ mādhvī̱ mama̍ śruta̱ṁ hava̍m ||
english: Dawn has come, with gleaming cattle; Agni has been set in the proper season; your chariot has been yoked, O ye whose wealth is the bull, O workers of wonder, immortal — hear my honeyed call.

sanskrit: ā bhā̍ty a̱gnir u̱ṣasā̱m anī̍ka̱m ud viprā̍ṇāṁ deva̱yā vāco̍ asthuḥ | a̱rvāñcā̍ nū̱naṁ ra̍thye̱ha yā̍tam pīpi̱vāṁsa̍m aśvinā gha̱rmam accha̍ ||
english: Agni blazes forth at the face of the Dawns; the god-seeking voices of the seers have risen up; come now hither with your chariot, O Aśvins, toward the gharma-vessel that has been made full.

sanskrit: na sa̍ṁskṛ̱tam pra mi̍mīto̱ gami̱ṣṭhānti̍ nū̱nam a̱śvinopa̍stute̱ha | divā̍bhipi̱tve 'va̱sāga̍miṣṭhā̱ praty ava̍rtiṁ dā̱śuṣe̱ śambha̍viṣṭhā ||
english: Ye do not violate what is prepared; come now most swiftly, O Aśvins, praised here; at the approach of the day come for our protection, and be most beneficent in return to the sacrificer.

sanskrit: u̱tā yā̍taṁ saṁga̱ve prā̱tar ahno̍ ma̱dhyaṁdi̍na̱ udi̍tā̱ sūrya̍sya | divā̱ nakta̱m ava̍sā̱ śaṁta̍mena̱ nedānī̍m pī̱tir a̱śvinā ta̍tāna ||
english: Come also at cow-gathering time, at the morning of the day, at midday when the sun has risen; by day and by night with most blissful protection — now the time for drinking, O Aśvins, has been extended.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ hi vā̍m pra̱divi̱ sthāna̱m oka̍ i̱me gṛ̱hā a̍śvine̱daṁ du̍ro̱ṇam | ā no̍ di̱vo bṛ̍ha̱taḥ parva̍tā̱d ādbhyo yā̍ta̱m iṣa̱m ūrja̱ṁ vaha̍ntā ||
english: This is indeed your ancient station, your home; these are the houses, O Aśvins, this the dwelling; come to us from the great heaven, from the mountain, from the waters, bringing refreshment and strength.

sanskrit: sam a̱śvino̱r ava̍sā̱ nūta̍nena mayo̱bhuvā̍ su̱praṇī̍tī gamema | ā no̍ ra̱yiṁ va̍hata̱m ota vī̱rān ā viśvā̍ny amṛtā̱ saubha̍gāni ||
english: May we go together with the new protection of the two Aśvins, the joy-bringing, of excellent guidance; bring us wealth and heroes; O immortals, bring all good fortunes.

sanskrit: prā̱ta̱ryāvā̍ṇā pratha̱mā ya̍jadhvam pu̱rā gṛdhrā̱d ara̍ruṣaḥ pibātaḥ | prā̱tar hi ya̱jñam a̱śvinā̍ da̱dhāte̱ pra śa̍ṁsanti ka̱vaya̍ḥ pūrva̱bhāja̍ḥ ||
english: Worship first these two who travel at dawn — before the vulture, may the ruddy ones drink; for it is at dawn that the two Aśvins establish the sacrifice; the poets who have the first share proclaim it.

sanskrit: prā̱tar ya̍jadhvam a̱śvinā̍ hinota̱ na sā̱yam a̍sti deva̱yā aju̍ṣṭam | u̱tānyo a̱smad ya̍jate̱ vi cāva̱ḥ pūrva̍ḥ-pūrvo̱ yaja̍māno̱ vanī̍yān ||
english: Worship the Aśvins at dawn, urge them on; at evening there is no sacrifice unaccomplished by the god-seekers; even another than us worships and is distinguished; each earlier sacrificer gains the better prize.

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyatva̱ṅ madhu̍varṇo ghṛ̱tasnu̱ḥ pṛkṣo̱ vaha̱nn ā ratho̍ vartate vām | mano̍javā aśvinā̱ vāta̍raṁhā̱ yenā̍tiyā̱tho du̍ri̱tāni̱ viśvā̍ ||
english: Of golden skin, honey-coloured, dripping ghee, bearing food-gifts, your chariot rolls forward; swift as thought, O Aśvins, racing like the wind, with it ye two pass over all adversities.

sanskrit: yo bhūyi̍ṣṭha̱ṁ nāsa̍tyābhyāṁ vi̱veṣa̱ cani̍ṣṭham pi̱tvo rara̍te vibhā̱ge | sa to̱kam a̍sya pīpara̱c chamī̍bhi̱r anū̍rdhvabhāsa̱ḥ sada̱m it tu̍turyāt ||
english: Whoever has served the two Nāsatyas most and has obtained the least in the division of food — may he nourish this man's offspring with toils; may he who shines not upward always overcome.

sanskrit: sam a̱śvino̱r ava̍sā̱ nūta̍nena mayo̱bhuvā̍ su̱praṇī̍tī gamema | ā no̍ ra̱yiṁ va̍hata̱m ota vī̱rān ā viśvā̍ny amṛtā̱ saubha̍gāni ||
english: May we go together with the new protection of the two Aśvins, the joy-bringing, of excellent guidance; bring us wealth and heroes; O immortals, bring all good fortunes.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱v eha ga̍cchata̱ṁ nāsa̍tyā̱ mā vi ve̍natam | ha̱ṁsāv i̍va patata̱m ā su̱tām̐ upa̍ ||
english: Come hither, O Aśvins, O Nāsatyas, do not fail to come; fly down like swans toward the pressed soma.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā hari̱ṇāv i̍va gau̱rāv i̱vānu̱ yava̍sam | ha̱ṁsāv i̍va patata̱m ā su̱tām̐ upa̍ ||
english: O Aśvins, like two antelopes, like two wild oxen following the pasture — fly down like swans toward the pressed soma.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā vājinīvasū ju̱ṣethā̍ṁ ya̱jñam i̱ṣṭaye̍ | ha̱ṁsāv i̍va patata̱m ā su̱tām̐ upa̍ ||
english: O Aśvins, O ye whose wealth is speed, delight in the sacrifice for the granting of the boon; fly down like swans toward the pressed soma.

sanskrit: atri̱r yad vā̍m ava̱roha̍nn ṛ̱bīsa̱m ajo̍havī̱n nādha̍māneva̱ yoṣā̍ | śye̱nasya̍ ci̱j java̍sā̱ nūta̍ne̱nāga̍cchatam aśvinā̱ śaṁta̍mena ||
english: When Atri, sliding down into the chasm, called to you, like a woman in need imploring — ye came with swiftness even rivalling a falcon, O Aśvins, with most blissful freshness.

sanskrit: vi ji̍hīṣva vanaspate̱ yoni̱ḥ sūṣya̍ntyā iva | śru̱tam me̍ aśvinā̱ hava̍ṁ sa̱ptava̍dhriṁ ca muñcatam ||
english: Open wide, O lord of the forest, like the womb of a woman about to give birth; O Aśvins, hear my call and release Saptavadhri.

sanskrit: bhī̱tāya̱ nādha̍mānāya̱ ṛṣa̍ye sa̱ptava̍dhraye | mā̱yābhi̍r aśvinā yu̱vaṁ vṛ̱kṣaṁ saṁ ca̱ vi cā̍cathaḥ ||
english: For the frightened, imploring seer Saptavadhri — by your miraculous arts, O Aśvins, ye split and opened the tree.

sanskrit: yathā̱ vāta̍ḥ puṣka̱riṇī̍ṁ sami̱ṅgaya̍ti sa̱rvata̍ḥ | e̱vā te̱ garbha̍ ejatu ni̱raitu̱ daśa̍māsyaḥ ||
english: As the wind stirs the lotus-pond on every side, so let your embryo stir; let the ten-month child come forth.

sanskrit: yathā̱ vāto̱ yathā̱ vana̱ṁ yathā̍ samu̱dra eja̍ti | e̱vā tvaṁ da̍śamāsya sa̱hāve̍hi ja̱rāyu̍ṇā ||
english: As the wind stirs, as the forest stirs, as the ocean stirs — so stir and come forth, O ten-month child, together with the after-birth.

sanskrit: daśa̱ māsā̍ñ chaśayā̱naḥ ku̍mā̱ro adhi̍ mā̱tari̍ | ni̱raitu̍ jī̱vo akṣa̍to jī̱vo jīva̍ntyā̱ adhi̍ ||
english: The boy who has lain ten months upon the mother — let him come forth alive, unharmed, alive, from her who is living.

sanskrit: ma̱he no̍ a̱dya bo̍dha̱yoṣo̍ rā̱ye di̱vitma̍tī | yathā̍ cin no̱ abo̍dhayaḥ sa̱tyaśra̍vasi vā̱yye sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Awaken us today, O Uṣas, possessor of heavenly light, to great wealth — as indeed thou hast awakened us before, O thou of true glory, of airy swiftness, nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: yā su̍nī̱the śau̍cadra̱the vy auccho̍ duhitar divaḥ | sā vy u̍ccha̱ sahī̍yasi sa̱tyaśra̍vasi vā̱yye sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: She who shone forth in good guidance, in the pure chariot, O daughter of heaven — that same one shine forth, and more powerfully, O thou of true glory, of airy swiftness, nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: sā no̍ a̱dyābha̱radva̍su̱r vy u̍cchā duhitar divaḥ | yo vy auccha̱ḥ sahī̍yasi sa̱tyaśra̍vasi vā̱yye sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: She who has been good, the treasure-bearer — let her shine forth today, O daughter of heaven; the one who shines more powerfully, O thou of true glory, of airy swiftness, nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: a̱bhi ye tvā̍ vibhāvari̱ stomai̍r gṛ̱ṇanti̱ vahna̍yaḥ | ma̱ghair ma̍ghoni su̱śriyo̱ dāma̍nvantaḥ surā̱taya̱ḥ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: They who, the priest-officants, laud thee with hymns, O Uṣas of brilliant light — with gifts, O one rich in gifts, of good glory, holding bounty, of excellent bestowal — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi te̍ ga̱ṇā i̱me cha̱daya̍nti ma̱ghatta̍ye | pari̍ ci̱d vaṣṭa̍yo dadhu̱r dada̍to̱ rādho̱ ahra̍ya̱ṁ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Even if these your companies veil themselves for the winning of bounties, even so the worshippers around have laid up unwithering largess from those who give — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: aiṣu̍ dhā vī̱rava̱d yaśa̱ uṣo̍ maghoni sū̱riṣu̍ | ye no̱ rādhā̱ṁsy ahra̍yā ma̱ghavā̍no̱ arā̍sata̱ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Place, O Uṣas, rich in gifts, heroic fame among these patrons of ours — the liberal ones who have bestowed on us unwithering treasures — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: tebhyo̍ dyu̱mnam bṛ̱had yaśa̱ uṣo̍ magho̱ny ā va̍ha | ye no̱ rādhā̱ṁsy aśvyā̍ ga̱vyā bhaja̍nta sū̱raya̱ḥ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Bring to those great brilliance and fame, O Uṣas rich in gifts — the patrons who have granted us treasures in horses and in cattle — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: u̱ta no̱ goma̍tī̱r iṣa̱ ā va̍hā duhitar divaḥ | sā̱kaṁ sūrya̍sya ra̱śmibhi̍ḥ śu̱kraiḥ śoca̍dbhir a̱rcibhi̱ḥ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Bring also to us refreshments rich in cattle, O daughter of heaven; bring them together with the rays of the sun, with the bright, blazing radiances — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: vy u̍cchā duhitar divo̱ mā ci̱raṁ ta̍nuthā̱ apa̍ḥ | net tvā̍ ste̱naṁ yathā̍ ri̱puṁ tapā̍ti̱ sūro̍ a̱rciṣā̱ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: Shine forth, O daughter of heaven; do not delay or thin out your works too long; lest the sun with his ray scorch thee like a thief or a foe — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: e̱tāva̱d ved u̍ṣa̱s tvam bhūyo̍ vā̱ dātu̍m arhasi | yā sto̱tṛbhyo̍ vibhāvary u̱cchantī̱ na pra̱mīya̍se̱ sujā̍te̱ aśva̍sūnṛte ||
english: This much thou knowest, O Uṣas, or more than this thou deservest to give — thou who, O brilliantly bright one, shining for the praisers, dost not perish — nobly born, O Uṣas rich in horses and vigour.

sanskrit: dyu̱tadyā̍mānam bṛha̱tīm ṛ̱tena̍ ṛ̱tāva̍rīm aru̱ṇapsu̍ṁ vibhā̱tīm | de̱vīm u̱ṣasa̱ṁ sva̍r ā̱vaha̍ntī̱m prati̱ viprā̍so ma̱tibhi̍r jarante ||
english: The brilliant-coursed, the great, established in truth, possessing the cosmic Order, rosy-complexioned, shining wide — the divine Dawn, the bringer of heavenly light: the inspired seers sing to her with their thoughts.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā jana̍ṁ darśa̱tā bo̱dhaya̍ntī su̱gān pa̱thaḥ kṛ̍ṇva̱tī yā̱ty agre̍ | bṛ̱ha̱dra̱thā bṛ̍ha̱tī vi̍śvami̱nvoṣā jyoti̍r yaccha̱ty agre̱ ahnā̍m ||
english: She, the visible, awakening the people and making the paths easy to travel, goes in front; lofty-charioted, the great Uṣas who pleases all extends the light at the front of the days.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā gobhi̍r aru̱ṇebhi̍r yujā̱nāsre̍dhantī ra̱yim aprā̍yu cakre | pa̱tho rada̍ntī suvi̱tāya̍ de̱vī pu̍ruṣṭu̱tā vi̱śvavā̍rā̱ vi bhā̍ti ||
english: She, yoked with ruddy cattle, without stumbling has made wealth without failing; the goddess who chisels the paths for well-being, much praised, all-desired, shines forth.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā vye̍nī bhavati dvi̱barhā̍ āviṣkṛṇvā̱nā ta̱nva̍m pu̱rastā̍t | ṛ̱tasya̱ panthā̱m anv e̍ti sā̱dhu pra̍jāna̱tīva̱ na diśo̍ mināti ||
english: She becomes the radiant one, wearing her double mantle, revealing her body in the east; she follows the path of the cosmic Order rightly, like one who knows it well; she does not confuse the directions.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā śu̱bhrā na ta̱nvo̍ vidā̱nordhveva̍ snā̱tī dṛ̱śaye̍ no asthāt | apa̱ dveṣo̱ bādha̍mānā̱ tamā̍ṁsy u̱ṣā di̱vo du̍hi̱tā jyoti̱ṣāgā̍t ||
english: She, brilliant like a pure body that has been known, as if bathed upright, has stood forth for our sight; pushing away enmities and darknesses, Uṣas, the daughter of heaven, has come with her light.

sanskrit: e̱ṣā pra̍tī̱cī du̍hi̱tā di̱vo nṝn yoṣe̍va bha̱drā ni ri̍ṇīte̱ apsa̍ḥ | vyū̱rṇva̱tī dā̱śuṣe̱ vāryā̍ṇi̱ puna̱r jyoti̍r yuva̱tiḥ pū̱rvathā̍kaḥ ||
english: She, the facing daughter of heaven, like an auspicious woman releases her activity toward men; unfolding the desirable gifts for the sacrificer, the young woman restores the light as it was before.

sanskrit: yu̱ñjate̱ mana̍ u̱ta yu̍ñjate̱ dhiyo̱ viprā̱ vipra̍sya bṛha̱to vi̍pa̱ścita̍ḥ | vi hotrā̍ dadhe vayunā̱vid eka̱ in ma̱hī de̱vasya̍ savi̱tuḥ pari̍ṣṭutiḥ ||
english: The inspired seers yoke the mind and yoke the thoughts of the great, inspired, omniscient one; he alone, the knower of right courses, distributes the priestly offices — great is the celebration of the god Savitṛ.

sanskrit: viśvā̍ rū̱pāṇi̱ prati̍ muñcate ka̱viḥ prāsā̍vīd bha̱draṁ dvi̱pade̱ catu̍ṣpade | vi nāka̍m akhyat savi̱tā vare̱ṇyo 'nu̍ pra̱yāṇa̍m u̱ṣaso̱ vi rā̍jati ||
english: The seer-poet releases all forms; he has impelled good fortune for bipeds and quadrupeds; Savitṛ the Adorable has surveyed the vault of heaven and shines brilliantly following the path of Uṣas.

sanskrit: yasya̍ pra̱yāṇa̱m anv a̱nya id ya̱yur de̱vā de̱vasya̍ mahi̱māna̱m oja̍sā | yaḥ pārthi̍vāni vima̱me sa eta̍śo̱ rajā̍ṁsi de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā ma̍hitva̱nā ||
english: Following whose procession other gods have gone, impelled by the greatness of the god with power; he who measured out the earthly realms — that vigorous Savitṛ, the god, with his greatness.

sanskrit: u̱ta yā̍si savita̱s trīṇi̍ roca̱nota sūrya̍sya ra̱śmibhi̱ḥ sam u̍cyasi | u̱ta rātrī̍m ubha̱yata̱ḥ parī̍yasa u̱ta mi̱tro bha̍vasi deva̱ dharma̍bhiḥ ||
english: And thou, O Savitṛ, goest to the three luminous realms, and thou art joined with the rays of the sun; thou goest around the night on both sides; and thou becomest Mitra, O god, by thy laws.

sanskrit: u̱teśi̍ṣe prasa̱vasya̱ tvam eka̱ id u̱ta pū̱ṣā bha̍vasi deva̱ yāma̍bhiḥ | u̱tedaṁ viśva̱m bhuva̍na̱ṁ vi rā̍jasi śyā̱vāśva̍s te savita̱ḥ stoma̍m ānaśe ||
english: And thou alone hast command of the impulse to motion, and thou becomest Pūṣan, O god, by thy courses; and thou reignest over all this world of beings — Śyāvāśva has obtained thy praise, O Savitṛ.

sanskrit: tat sa̍vi̱tur vṛ̍ṇīmahe va̱yaṁ de̱vasya̱ bhoja̍nam | śreṣṭha̍ṁ sarva̱dhāta̍ma̱ṁ tura̱m bhaga̍sya dhīmahi ||
english: We choose that boon of Savitṛ, the divine bestowal; we meditate upon the most excellent, all-sustaining, swift portion of the Bhaga.

sanskrit: asya̱ hi svaya̍śastaraṁ savi̱tuḥ kac ca̱na pri̱yam | na mi̱nanti̍ sva̱rājya̍m ||
english: For of this Savitṛ who is more self-resplendent, no one diminishes any dear thing, no one diminishes his self-sovereignty.

sanskrit: sa hi ratnā̍ni dā̱śuṣe̍ su̱vāti̍ savi̱tā bhaga̍ḥ | tam bhā̱gaṁ ci̱tram ī̍mahe ||
english: For he — Savitṛ the Bhaga — impels his treasures toward the worshipper; that brilliant portion do we seek.

sanskrit: a̱dyā no̍ deva savitaḥ pra̱jāva̍t sāvī̱ḥ saubha̍gam | parā̍ du̱ṣṣvapnya̍ṁ suva ||
english: Today, O god Savitṛ, impel for us good fortune with offspring; drive away the evil dream.

sanskrit: viśvā̍ni deva savitar duri̱tāni̱ parā̍ suva | yad bha̱draṁ tan na̱ ā su̍va ||
english: All adversities, O god Savitṛ, drive away; what is auspicious, that impel toward us.

sanskrit: anā̍gaso̱ adi̍taye de̱vasya̍ savi̱tuḥ sa̱ve | viśvā̍ vā̱māni̍ dhīmahi ||
english: At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, for the sinless Aditi, may we meditate upon all desirable things.

sanskrit: ā vi̱śvade̍va̱ṁ satpa̍tiṁ sū̱ktair a̱dyā vṛ̍ṇīmahe | sa̱tyasa̍vaṁ savi̱tāra̍m ||
english: Today with our well-spoken hymns we choose the lord of all gods, the lord of good men, Savitṛ of true impulse.

sanskrit: ya i̱me u̱bhe aha̍nī pu̱ra ety apra̍yucchan | svā̱dhīr de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā ||
english: He who goes before both days — the day and the night — without faltering: the god Savitṛ of excellent intelligence.

sanskrit: ya i̱mā viśvā̍ jā̱tāny ā̍śrā̱vaya̍ti̱ śloke̍na | pra ca̍ su̱vāti̍ savi̱tā ||
english: He who makes all these beings hear by his sound, and impels them onward — that is Savitṛ.

sanskrit: acchā̍ vada ta̱vasa̍ṁ gī̱rbhir ā̱bhiḥ stu̱hi pa̱rjanya̱ṁ nama̱sā vi̍vāsa | kani̍kradad vṛṣa̱bho jī̱radā̍nū̱ reto̍ dadhā̱ty oṣa̍dhīṣu̱ garbha̍m ||
english: Speak toward the mighty one with these songs; praise Parjanya with homage, seek to please him; the bull who cries aloud, who grants life swiftly, places his seed as an embryo in the plants.

sanskrit: vi vṛ̱kṣān ha̍nty u̱ta ha̍nti ra̱kṣaso̱ viśva̍m bibhāya̱ bhuva̍nam ma̱hāva̍dhāt | u̱tānā̍gā īṣate̱ vṛṣṇyā̍vato̱ yat pa̱rjanya̍ḥ sta̱naya̱n hanti̍ du̱ṣkṛta̍ḥ ||
english: He smites the trees and smites also the demons; all the world is afraid before his great weapon; even the guiltless flee before the bull's power, when Parjanya, thundering, smites the evil-doers.

sanskrit: ra̱thīva̱ kaśa̱yāśvā̍m̐ abhikṣi̱pann ā̱vir dū̱tān kṛ̍ṇute va̱rṣyā̱3̱̍m̐ aha̍ | dū̱rāt si̱ṁhasya̍ sta̱nathā̱ ud ī̍rate̱ yat pa̱rjanya̍ḥ kṛṇu̱te va̱rṣya1̱̍ṁ nabha̍ḥ ||
english: Like a charioteer lashing horses with the whip, he makes visible his messengers of rain; from afar the roarings of a lion arise when Parjanya makes the rain-cloud.

sanskrit: pra vātā̱ vānti̍ pa̱taya̍nti vi̱dyuta̱ ud oṣa̍dhī̱r jiha̍te̱ pinva̍te̱ sva̍ḥ | irā̱ viśva̍smai̱ bhuva̍nāya jāyate̱ yat pa̱rjanya̍ḥ pṛthi̱vīṁ reta̱sāva̍ti ||
english: The winds blow forward, lightnings fly down, plants rise up, heaven swells; nourishment is born for the whole world when Parjanya fertilises the earth with his seed.

sanskrit: yasya̍ vra̱te pṛ̍thi̱vī nanna̍mīti̱ yasya̍ vra̱te śa̱phava̱j jarbhu̍rīti | yasya̍ vra̱ta oṣa̍dhī̱r vi̱śvarū̍pā̱ḥ sa na̍ḥ parjanya̱ mahi̱ śarma̍ yaccha ||
english: At whose ordinance the earth bends down, at whose ordinance hoofed animals tremble, at whose ordinance the plants of all forms flourish — O Parjanya, grant us great shelter.

sanskrit: di̱vo no̍ vṛ̱ṣṭim ma̍ruto rarīdhva̱m pra pi̍nvata̱ vṛṣṇo̱ aśva̍sya̱ dhārā̍ḥ | a̱rvāṅ e̱tena̍ stanayi̱tnunehy a̱po ni̍ṣi̱ñcann asu̍raḥ pi̱tā na̍ḥ ||
english: Grant us the rain of heaven, O Maruts; let the streams of the potent stallion flow forth; come hither with this thunder, O mighty one, O father, pouring down the waters.

sanskrit: a̱bhi kra̍nda sta̱naya̱ garbha̱m ā dhā̍ uda̱nvatā̱ pari̍ dīyā̱ rathe̍na | dṛti̱ṁ su ka̍rṣa̱ viṣi̍ta̱ṁ nya̍ñcaṁ sa̱mā bha̍vantū̱dvato̍ nipā̱dāḥ ||
english: Cry out, thunder, place the embryo; fly around with the water-bearing chariot; draw well the full waterbag downward; let the high places and the low become level.

sanskrit: ma̱hānta̱ṁ kośa̱m ud a̍cā̱ ni ṣi̍ñca̱ syanda̍ntāṁ ku̱lyā viṣi̍tāḥ pu̱rastā̍t | ghṛ̱tena̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī vy u̍ndhi suprapā̱ṇam bha̍vatv a̱ghnyābhya̍ḥ ||
english: Lift up the great bucket and pour it down; let the streams that have been released flow forward; drench heaven and earth with ghee; let there be good watering for the cows.

sanskrit: yat pa̍rjanya̱ kani̍kradat sta̱naya̱n haṁsi̍ du̱ṣkṛta̍ḥ | pratī̱daṁ viśva̍m modate̱ yat kiṁ ca̍ pṛthi̱vyām adhi̍ ||
english: When Parjanya, crying aloud and thundering, smites the evil-doers, all this universe rejoices — whatever there is upon the earth.

sanskrit: ava̍rṣīr va̱rṣam ud u̱ ṣū gṛ̍bhā̱yāka̱r dhanvā̱ny atye̍ta̱vā u̍ | ajī̍jana̱ oṣa̍dhī̱r bhoja̍nāya̱ kam u̱ta pra̱jābhyo̍ 'vido manī̱ṣām ||
english: Thou hast poured down rain; now withhold it again; thou hast made the deserts crossable; thou hast generated the plants for nourishment; thou hast found wisdom also for the offspring.

sanskrit: baḻ i̱tthā parva̍tānāṁ khi̱dram bi̍bharṣi pṛthivi | pra yā bhūmi̍m pravatvati ma̱hnā ji̱noṣi̍ mahini ||
english: Yes, truly so, O Pṛthivī — thou bearest the cleft of the mountains; thou who quickenest and settest the earth in motion with greatness, O mighty one.

sanskrit: stomā̍sas tvā vicāriṇi̱ prati̍ ṣṭobhanty a̱ktubhi̍ḥ | pra yā vāja̱ṁ na heṣa̍ntam pe̱rum asya̍sy arjuni ||
english: The hymns of praise respond to thee at night with their refrains, O thou who movest everywhere; thou who shootest the obstacle forward like a neighing steed, O bright one.

sanskrit: dṛ̱ḻhā ci̱d yā vana̱spatī̍n kṣma̱yā dardha̱rṣy oja̍sā | yat te̍ a̱bhrasya̍ vi̱dyuto̍ di̱vo varṣa̍nti vṛ̱ṣṭaya̍ḥ ||
english: Even the firm trees thou shakest with the earth through thy power; when thy rains rain down from the lightning of the cloud of heaven.

sanskrit: pra sa̱mrāje̍ bṛ̱had a̍rcā gabhī̱ram brahma̍ pri̱yaṁ varu̍ṇāya śru̱tāya̍ | vi yo ja̱ghāna̍ śami̱teva̱ carmo̍pa̱stire̍ pṛthi̱vīṁ sūryā̍ya ||
english: Sing forth the great, deep, beloved prayer to the sovereign Varuṇa who is widely heard — who spread the earth as a slaughterer does a hide, for the sun to tread on.

sanskrit: vane̍ṣu̱ vy a1̱̍ntari̍kṣaṁ tatāna̱ vāja̱m arva̍tsu̱ paya̍ u̱sriyā̍su | hṛ̱tsu kratu̱ṁ varu̍ṇo a̱psv a1̱̍gniṁ di̱vi sūrya̍m adadhā̱t soma̱m adrau̍ ||
english: He stretched out the firmament through the forests, speed in the steeds, milk in the cows; in hearts he placed purposeful will, fire in the waters, the sun in heaven, Soma on the rock.

sanskrit: nī̱cīna̍bāra̱ṁ varu̍ṇa̱ḥ kava̍ndha̱m pra sa̍sarja̱ roda̍sī a̱ntari̍kṣam | tena̱ viśva̍sya̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̱ yava̱ṁ na vṛ̱ṣṭir vy u̍natti̱ bhūma̍ ||
english: Varuṇa poured forth the cask whose opening turns downward through heaven, earth, and the mid-air; with it the king of all the world wets the earth like rain wetting the barley-crop.

sanskrit: u̱natti̱ bhūmi̍m pṛthi̱vīm u̱ta dyāṁ ya̱dā du̱dghaṁ varu̍ṇo̱ vaṣṭy ād it | sam a̱bhreṇa̍ vasata̱ parva̍tāsas taviṣī̱yanta̍ḥ śrathayanta vī̱rāḥ ||
english: He wets the earth and the broad sky whenever Varuṇa wishes to milk it; the mountains clothe themselves with cloud, the heroes — growing mighty — loosen their strength.

sanskrit: i̱mām ū̱ ṣv ā̍su̱rasya̍ śru̱tasya̍ ma̱hīm mā̱yāṁ varu̍ṇasya̱ pra vo̍cam | māne̍neva tasthi̱vām̐ a̱ntari̍kṣe̱ vi yo ma̱me pṛ̍thi̱vīṁ sūryē̱ṇa ||
english: Of this celebrated Asura, Varuṇa — his great magical power have I now declared; he who, as if standing in the mid-air with a measuring rod, measured out the earth by means of the sun.

sanskrit: i̱mām ū̱ nu ka̱vita̍masya mā̱yām ma̱hīṁ de̱vasya̱ naki̱r ā da̍dharṣa | eka̱ṁ yad u̱dnā na pṛ̱ṇanty enī̍r āsi̱ñcantī̍r a̱vana̍yaḥ samu̱dram ||
english: This great magical power of the most wise god — no one has dared to approach it; for the shining rivers, pouring their streams, do not fill the single ocean.

sanskrit: a̱rya̱mya̍ṁ varuṇa mi̱trya̍ṁ vā̱ sakhā̍yaṁ vā̱ sada̱m id bhrāta̍raṁ vā | ve̱śaṁ vā̱ nitya̍ṁ varu̱ṇāra̍ṇaṁ vā̱ yat sī̱m āga̍ś cakṛ̱mā śi̱śratha̱s tat ||
english: An Aryaman's man, O Varuṇa, or a friend of Mitra, or a comrade, or even an eternal brother, or a housemate, or a stranger, O Varuṇa — whatever wrong we have done to such, loosen thou that.

sanskrit: ki̱ta̱vāso̱ yad ri̍ri̱pur na dī̱vi yad vā̍ ghā sa̱tyam u̱ta yan na vi̱dma | sarvā̱ tā vi ṣya̍ śithi̱reva̍ de̱vādhā̍ te syāma varuṇa pri̱yāsa̍ḥ ||
english: As gamblers cheat — what wrong we have done as if in play, or what we have done that is a true transgression, or what we know not — loosen all that, O god, as if it were a loosened knot; then may we be dear to thee, O Varuṇa.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī̱ yam ava̍tha u̱bhā vāje̍ṣu̱ martya̍m | dṛ̱ḻhā ci̱t sa pra bhe̍dati dyu̱mnā vāṇī̍r iva tri̱taḥ ||
english: The mortal whom ye two, O Indra and Agni, both help in the battles — even the firm obstacles does he break through, like brilliant words, as Trita does.

sanskrit: yā pṛta̍nāsu du̱ṣṭarā̱ yā vāje̍ṣu śra̱vāyyā̍ | yā pañca̍ carṣa̱ṇīr a̱bhī̍ndrā̱gnī tā ha̍vāmahe ||
english: That power which is hard to overcome in battles, which is praiseworthy in contests, which encompasses the five peoples — O Indra and Agni, we invoke that power of yours.

sanskrit: tayo̱r id ama̍va̱c chava̍s ti̱gmā di̱dyun ma̱ghono̍ḥ | prati̱ druṇā̱ gabha̍styo̱r gavā̍ṁ vṛtra̱ghna eṣa̍te ||
english: The mighty, powerful strength of those two bountiful ones — their sharp lightning — in the fists that are strong as wood, the slayer of Vṛtra seeks the cows.

sanskrit: tā vā̱m eṣe̱ rathā̍nām indrā̱gnī ha̍vāmahe | patī̍ tu̱rasya̱ rādha̍so vi̱dvāṁsā̱ girva̍ṇastamā ||
english: In pursuit of the chariots we invoke you two, O Indra and Agni, lords of swift bounty, most knowing, most deserving of praise in song.

sanskrit: tā vṛ̱dhantā̱v anu̱ dyūn martā̍ya de̱vāv a̱dabhā̍ | arha̍ntā cit pu̱ro da̱dhe 'ṁśe̍va de̱vāv arva̍te ||
english: Both gods, growing in power through the days for the mortal, undeceived — even what is fitting do they set before him, like the two gods setting the portion for the steed.

sanskrit: e̱vendrā̱gnibhyā̱m ahā̍vi ha̱vyaṁ śū̱ṣya̍ṁ ghṛ̱taṁ na pū̱tam adri̍bhiḥ | tā sū̱riṣu̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱had ra̱yiṁ gṛ̱ṇatsu̍ didhṛta̱m iṣa̱ṁ gṛ̱ṇatsu̍ didhṛtam ||
english: Thus was the oblation offered to Indra and Agni — vigorous, pure as ghee pressed by stones; for those two establish great fame among the patrons and wealth for those who praise, nourishment for those who praise.

sanskrit: pra vo̍ ma̱he ma̱tayo̍ yantu̱ viṣṇa̍ve ma̱rutva̍te giri̱jā e̍va̱yāma̍rut | pra śardhā̍ya̱ praya̍jyave sukhā̱daye̍ ta̱vase̍ bha̱ndadi̍ṣṭaye̱ dhuni̍vratāya̱ śava̍se ||
english: Let your great hymns go forth to Viṣṇu accompanied by the Maruts, born on the mountains — Evayāmarut; go forth to the troop that receives worship well, the joy-giver, the powerful, to him of the best aim, of roaring ordinance, of might.

sanskrit: pra ye jā̱tā ma̍hi̱nā ye ca̱ nu sva̱yam pra vi̱dmanā̍ bru̱vata̍ eva̱yāma̍rut | kratvā̱ tad vo̍ maruto̱ nādhṛṣe̱ śavo̍ dā̱nā ma̱hnā tad e̍ṣā̱m adhṛ̍ṣṭāso̱ nādra̍yaḥ ||
english: They who were born great in greatness and who now of themselves, by their knowing, speak forth — Evayāmarut; by their will, O Maruts, that indomitable power of yours, their giving in greatness — these indomitable ones are like mountains.

sanskrit: pra ye di̱vo bṛ̍ha̱taḥ śṛ̍ṇvi̱re gi̱rā su̱śukvā̍naḥ su̱bhva̍ eva̱yāma̍rut | na yeṣā̱m irī̍ sa̱dhastha̱ īṣṭa̱ ām̐ a̱gnayo̱ na svavi̍dyuta̱ḥ pra sya̱ndrāso̱ dhunī̍nām ||
english: They who are heard from the great heaven by their song, blazing brightly, of beautiful forms — Evayāmarut; of these, no enemy desires their assembly; they are like fires, they who have their own lightning, who shoot forward like the torrents of rivers.

sanskrit: sa ca̍krame maha̱to nir u̍rukra̱maḥ sa̍mā̱nasmā̱t sada̍sa eva̱yāma̍rut | ya̱dāyu̍kta̱ tmanā̱ svād adhi̱ ṣṇubhi̱r viṣpa̍rdhaso̱ vima̍haso̱ jigā̍ti̱ śevṛ̍dho̱ nṛbhi̍ḥ ||
english: He of wide stride strode forth from the great, common seat — Evayāmarut; when he yoked himself on his own glorious, gleaming peaks, the strife-winner, the mighty one, goes accompanied by the men who increase his joy.

sanskrit: sva̱no na vo 'ma̍vān rejaya̱d vṛṣā̍ tve̱ṣo ya̱yis ta̍vi̱ṣa e̍va̱yāma̍rut | yenā̱ saha̍nta ṛ̱ñjata̱ svaro̍ciṣa̱ḥ sthāra̍śmāno hira̱ṇyayā̍ḥ svāyu̱dhāsa̍ i̱ṣmiṇa̍ḥ ||
english: Like the roaring of thunder, the mighty bull shook you, the fierce, rushing, powerful one — Evayāmarut; by whom, victorious and going straight, those self-luminous ones, firm as rocks, golden, of good weapons, of impulse, do conquer.

sanskrit: a̱pā̱ro vo̍ mahi̱mā vṛ̍ddhaśavasas tve̱ṣaṁ śavo̍ 'vatv eva̱yāma̍rut | sthātā̍ro̱ hi prasi̍tau sa̱ṁdṛśi̱ sthana̱ te na̍ uruṣyatā ni̱daḥ śu̍śu̱kvāṁso̱ nāgnaya̍ḥ ||
english: Your greatness is boundless, O ye of increased might; may the fierce power protect — Evayāmarut; for ye are standers in the front battle line; standing there, ye protect from bonds; blazing like fires.

sanskrit: te ru̱drāsa̱ḥ suma̍khā a̱gnayo̍ yathā tuvidyu̱mnā a̍vantv eva̱yāma̍rut | dī̱rgham pṛ̱thu pa̍prathe̱ sadma̱ pārthi̍va̱ṁ yeṣā̱m ajme̱ṣv ā ma̱haḥ śardhā̱ṁsy adbhu̍tainasām ||
english: Those Rudrās, of good sacrifice, blazing like fires, of great brilliance — may they protect, Evayāmarut; the earthly dwelling-place has spread out long and wide for them, at whose marches the great troops of those with wondrous power gather.

sanskrit: a̱dve̱ṣo no̍ maruto gā̱tum eta̍na̱ śrotā̱ hava̍ṁ jari̱tur e̍va̱yāma̍rut | viṣṇo̍r ma̱haḥ sa̍manyavo yuyotana̱ smad ra̱thyo̱3̱̍ na da̱ṁsanāpa̱ dveṣā̍ṁsi sanu̱taḥ ||
english: Without enmity, O Maruts, find a path for us; O Evayāmarut, hear the call of the singer; share ye in Viṣṇu's great energy — like a charioteer skilled in craft, drive enmities far away from us.

sanskrit: gantā̍ no ya̱jñaṁ ya̍jñiyāḥ su̱śami̱ śrotā̱ hava̍m ara̱kṣa e̍va̱yāma̍rut | jyeṣṭhā̍so̱ na parva̍tāso̱ vyo̍mani yū̱yaṁ tasya̍ pracetasa̱ḥ syāta̍ du̱rdharta̍vo ni̱daḥ ||
english: O worthy of worship, go to our sacrifice which is beautifully completed; O Evayāmarut, hear the call of the unharmed one; being like the greatest mountains in the sky, may ye, the all-knowing ones, be hard to seize and restrain the bonds.
